scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run verify:oauth-registration && electron dist/main.js
scripts.package:prepackaged: npm run verify:packaged-oauth && npm run verify:packaged-backend && node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --config electron-builder.json --win nsis --publish never --prepackaged release/win-unpacked
scripts.package:win: npm run verify:oauth-registration && npm run prepare:backend-runtime && node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --config electron-builder.json --win nsis --publish never && npm run verify:packaged-oauth && npm run verify:packaged-backend
scripts.package:win:release: npm run verify:oauth-registration && npm run prepare:backend-runtime && node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --config electron-builder.json --win nsis --publish never && npm run verify:packaged-oauth && npm run verify:packaged-backend
scripts.package:win:dir: npm run verify:oauth-registration && npm run prepare:backend-runtime && node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --config electron-builder.json --win dir --publish never && npm run verify:packaged-oauth && npm run verify:packaged-backend
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run verify:oauth-registration && npm_config_arch=x64 npm run prepare:backend-runtime && node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --config electron-builder.json --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run verify:oauth-registration && npm_config_arch=arm64 npm run prepare:backend-runtime && node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --config electron-builder.json --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:dir:x64: npm run verify:oauth-registration && npm_config_arch=x64 npm run prepare:backend-runtime && node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --config electron-builder.json --mac dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:dir:arm64: npm run verify:oauth-registration && npm_config_arch=arm64 npm run prepare:backend-runtime && node ./scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --config electron-builder.json --mac dir --arm64 --publish never
